notablePrerequisites: Lands you control that enter the battlefield untapped can produce at least {7}{W}{W}.
description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {7}{W}{W}.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing a land, causing you to gain two life.
Repeat step 2 for each other land you control.
Activate Codex Shredder by paying {5}, tapping and sacrificing it, returning Second Sunrise from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Second Sunrise by paying {1}{W}{W}, returning all artifacts, lands, creatures and enchantments that were put into a graveyard this turn onto the battlefield under their owner's control.
Sunscorched Desert enters the battlefield, dealing 1 damage to target player.
Repeat.
